interest: Indexes 1930s-40 reports tracking Japan's gold shipments, SEC action on bond syndicates, French litigation, and Manchurian corporate finance.
overview: This file comprises eighteen pages of the U.S. State Department's central decimal docket register ('List of Papers') for classification 894.51 (Japan: Financial Conditions, Budget, Debt, Bond Issues, Loans, Public Securities, Credits), spanning primarily 1937 to 1939 with specialized ancillary dockets dating from 1928 to 1945. Pages 1 through 12 form an unbroken docket sequence (Sheets 59 through 70) indexing documents #568 to #655, which track Japan's mounting financial strain during the Sino-Japanese conflict, including multi-billion yen wartime emergency budgets, large gold shipments from Kobe to San Francisco for the U.S. Treasury, the contraction of Anglo-American commercial credit lines, attempts to secure Swiss loans, and domestic drives to absorb national bonds. The remaining pages index specialized intelligence reports from the Military Intelligence Division (M.I.D.) and Office of Naval Intelligence (O.N.I.), as well as specific corporate, municipal, and institutional sub-dockets concerning the South Manchuria Railway, Toho Electric Power Company, French bondholders' litigation over the 1912 City of Tokyo loan, and the Yokohama Specie Bank.

subfiles.about: Docket ledger indexing State Department correspondence, telegrams, despatches, and memoranda concerning Japanese budgets, gold shipments, bond offerings, and credit negotiations from March 1938 to December 1939.
subfiles.summary: This 12-page central docket ledger (Sheets 59 through 70) indexes documents #568 through #655 in decimal file 894.51 between March 1938 and December 1939. It records diplomatic and consular reporting on Japan's wartime expenditures for the China Incident, recurring shipments of gold bullion from Kobe to San Francisco for the account of the U.S. Treasury, and investigations into unauthorized sales of Japanese government bonds in San Francisco and Hawaii. The docket also tracks American and British governmental attitudes toward restricting credits to Japan, diplomatic efforts to block Japanese credit negotiations in Switzerland, and repeated private legal inquiries regarding lost Japanese bonds belonging to the Oliver D. Hovey estate.
subfiles.title: State Department List of Papers: Financial Affairs of Japan (File 894.51, Sheets 59-70)

subfiles.about: Docket list recording intelligence reports submitted by the U.S. Military Attaché in Japan regarding government budgets and national gold reserves from October 1937 to December 1939.
subfiles.summary: Indexes seven 1937-39 Military Attaché reports on Japanese budgets, appropriations, and gold reserve management under the Gold Hoarding Law.
subfiles.title: State Department List of Papers: Military Intelligence Division Reports on Financial Affairs of Japan

subfiles.about: Docket sheet indexing a Navy Department intelligence report on Japanese government budget estimates for the fiscal year 1934-1935.
subfiles.from: Office of Naval Intelligence, Navy Department
subfiles.summary: Indexes a December 1934 Navy intelligence report on Japanese government fiscal estimates for 1934-1935.
subfiles.title: State Department List of Papers: Office of Naval Intelligence Reports on Financial Affairs of Japan

subfiles.about: Docket sheet indexing communications from March 1932 regarding the South Manchuria Railway's maturing sterling bond issue and domestic loan efforts.
subfiles.summary: Indexes March 1932 entries on the maturing South Manchuria Railway sterling bond and SMR domestic borrowing for Manchurian development.
subfiles.title: State Department List of Papers: Financial Affairs of the South Manchuria Railway

subfiles.about: Docket sheet indexing a memorandum concerning the maturity of the Toho Electric Power Company bond issue in 1932.
subfiles.summary: Indexes a 1928 Feis memo on the Toho Electric Power Company's 11,450,000-yen bond issue, maturing July 1932.
subfiles.title: State Department List of Papers: Financial Affairs of the Toho Electric Power Company, Ltd.

subfiles.about: Docket sheet indexing diplomatic despatches from the U.S. Embassy in Paris on French court litigation over the City of Tokyo 5% Loan of 1912.
subfiles.summary: Indexes five 1930-39 French despatches on litigation over the City of Tokyo's 1912 loan, ending in a 1939 gold-sterling settlement.
subfiles.title: State Department List of Papers: French Litigation over the City of Tokyo 5% Loan of 1912

subfiles.about: Docket sheet indexing memoranda on credit advances and foreign banking offers involving the Yokohama Specie Bank in 1929 and 1930.
subfiles.summary: Indexes January 1930 entries on American credits to the Yokohama Specie Bank and Feis's memo on a renewed 127,000,000-yen advance.
subfiles.title: State Department List of Papers: Financial Affairs of the Yokohama Specie Bank
